mapper.insert: INSERT INTO urls (original_url, short_code, click_count, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{originalUrl}, #{shortCode}, #{clickCount}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, original_url, short_code, click_count, created_at, expires_at FROM urls ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM urls WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < NOW()
